subject: Post-call: Atlas Health sponsor recap, pilot metrics & procurement path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Hart <lydia.hart@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-21T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot metrics and next steps

Hi Lydia —

Thanks for carving out time today. Quick written recap so we’re aligned with your execs. I’ve attached a one-pager and a draft MAP (mutual action plan). Key points we captured: 

- Business goals: improve LLM-powered triage accuracy and reduce median inference latency to improve clinician UX during peak loads (target: 95th pct latency < 300ms for typical 512-token prompts).
- Primary pain: unpredictable p99 latency spikes on current vendor during concurrent chart-processing windows; that creates clinician timeouts and fails the async flow.
- Compliance constraint: Atlas must keep PHI in-scope for pilot; preference for VPC/private deployment or dedicated tenancy in our US region with audit logs and encryption-at-rest/HSM KMS.
- Cost target: pilot target unit economics ~ $0.045-$0.07 per 1k tokens (we'll model multiple throughput scenarios).

Pilot proposal (high level): 3-week technical pilot + 4-week ramp, scope = 50k–150k tokens/day (starting low and scaling), success metrics = p99 latency consistently < 450ms during synthetic peak, decreased KV cache miss rate vs baseline, no data egress violations.

Open asks from Atlas: SOC 2 report, security questionnaire, legal/contracting timeline, and whether you can commit a pilot PO if technical requirements are met.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I’ll share the security evidence pack and MAP (attached).
2) Aditya to schedule a 60m technical deep-dive with your infra/ML engineering next week to validate KV cache approach and deployment mode.
3) Priya to coordinate with your procurement/legal on expected timeline for a pilot SOW + PO path.

Attachments: atlas-postcall-onepager.pdf (1p), atlas-map-v1.xlsx (MAP draft).

Thanks again — we’ll be ready to move fast once the security checklist is green.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0261

From: Lydia Hart <lydia.hart@atlashealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Weber <m.weber@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot metrics and next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. A couple quick clarifications from the sponsor side: 

- Pilot success metrics: we want the definition to include an operational SLA for timeouts in our UI (e.g., < 2% request timeouts during peak). Can you map your p99 targets to our UI-timeout metric?
- Data residency: we cannot allow PHI to leave the US East region; will Redwood host the pilot in a single physical region?
- Pricing: please send a bulleted price band for the pilot (low/expected/high) and an estimate of monthly cost at 150k tokens/day.

We’ll also need a reference that has run a private/dedicated deployment for healthcare. Markus — please add any legal/procurement timeline notes.

Thanks,
Lydia Hart
VP Digital Transformation | Atlas Health
lydia.hart@atlashealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-22T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + proposed pilot metrics and next steps

Team — forwarding Lydia’s notes and my recap. Action items and owners below (please treat this as time-sensitive; Atlas is aiming to move the pilot within 2 weeks if security checks out).

---- Forwarded message ----
From: Lydia Hart <lydia.hart@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot metrics and next steps

[see above] 

---- end forwarded ----

Action items:
- Aditya: schedule 60m deep-dive with Atlas infra/ML (include a short agenda: KV cache behavior, batching strategy, p99 tests, deployment topology). Target meeting before 2026-06-25.
- Priya: prep the security evidence pack for PHI (SOC 2, encryption-at-rest details, KMS/HSM approach, audit log capabilities). I attached the MAP and a one-pager; add any additional artifacts Atlas will need and flag gaps.
- Priyom: build a quick cost model (3 scenarios: 50k/100k/150k tokens/day) with unit costs and estimated GPU hours; call out any savings from prefix/KV caching and dedicated pools. Please include an estimated pilot PO figure.
- Legal/Contracts: anticipate redlines on data residency + indemnity clauses; expect 1–2 week turnaround once they have the SOW. I’ll introduce our legal contacts after we confirm pilot scope.

Risks/esc will need leadership awareness: 
- CISO involvement: Atlas requires CISO sign-off for PHI handling — Priya, can you own the initial exchange and propose a live session with their CISO?
- SLA expectations: if Atlas needs a 99th < 300ms hard SLO, we will need Dedicated pools and may need a short performance tuning window; that impacts pricing.

Please update this thread with status updates and copy me on all external-facing replies so Lydia sees one coherent voice.

Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap + proposed pilot metrics and next steps

Got it — I’ll take the deep-dive. Plan:
1) Share 45m slot options for 6/24–6/25 and include a short pre-read (architecture + expected traffic patterns).
2) Quick sanity run: we’ll run a synthetic p99 baseline against a compatible model and capture kv-cache miss-rate impact; results back to Lydia by EOD 6/25.
3) I’ll draft the pilot runbook (ops checklist, who does what during ramp) and include a short note on why Dedicated is recommended if they want p99 < 300ms.

I’ll attach the pre-read after scheduling.

—Aditya
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
